title: ARCADE: SCREEN WAKE LOCK
why: His yes to the five recommendations for the Halloween party mode, arcade24. The party machine sits on the attract loop for hours with nobody touching it, and a monitor that goes to sleep looks like a broken game. While the arcade is on, each window now asks the browser to keep its screen awake. The browser lets go of that whenever the tab is hidden, so it is asked for again when the tab comes back, and it is let go when the arcade is left. Browsers that do not offer it, or refuse it, play exactly as before. Normal play never asks for it.
now: While the arcade is on the screens stay awake, and leaving the arcade lets them sleep again.
